title: Unit Event — Deeper and Deeper — Episode1 An Unexpected Opportunity

meta.Event Outline: Wonderlands×Showtime agrees to participate in a workshop run by ArcLand. As Rui takes the directors' course, he is confronted with something he's never realized about himself before.

rows.Speaker: Announcement
rows.Line:
<Welcome to Tokyo ArcLand.
The place where your most wonderful dreams come true.>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Whoa...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wow!
The ground's all sparkly and lit up!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: They're using interactive projection mapping.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Sensors detect guests' movements, and project interactive images to follow them.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Hey, you're right.
The lights change colors as you walk.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: This is so cool! And if you go hop-hoppity-hopscotch, then you can get them to pop and shimmer!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Wait, where are you going?!
We aren't here to enjoy the park, you know!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
I forgot!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Honestly...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Still, we've been to a lot of amazing places until now... But I really wasn't expecting to get a chance to train here.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Me neither. After all, ArcLand is one of the few world-class amusement parks that are able to compete against Riley Dream Park.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Naturally, its doors are not opened for very many at all...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We really must thank Keisuke and Shosuke again.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We get to train with a fourth troupe?!

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line:
Yes, at ArcLand.
I'm sure you're all familiar.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What...?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: ArcLand? Where Asahi and his friends work?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes...
But ArcLand puts on some of the best shows in the world.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Why are we getting a chance to train there?
We have performed with them in the past, but even so...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: We've actually been reaching out for quite a while now. Unlike last time, which both parties saw as a collaborative effort, this time we're asking them for a massive favor.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: They kept turning us away, but we managed to get their approval just recently.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I see.
But why now?

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: As you all know, ArcLand is home to many talented young actors and directors.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: They're going to be holding an internal workshop as a way to help them improve their skills.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: A workshop...?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Could it be that... We've been invited to participate, as well?

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line:
That's right.
They said that you'd be welcome to join if you're free.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But an internal workshop will naturally be designed for the cast members and directors of ArcLand...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I have to think they're going to be running some very demanding activities.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
Yes, I agree.
But it should be a good experience for all of you.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: What do you say? The decision is yours.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Of course we're going!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (After turning down their offer last time, I didn't think we'd be asked to work with them again.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What's wrong, Nene? You keep looking all around.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, so...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: They said that someone would come and get us, so I was keeping an eye out for...
Hey!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, right on cue!
se_run_men_001_1
Thank you all for waiting! Long time no see.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: And welcome to Tokyo ArcLand!

rows.Speaker: Emu & Nene
rows.Line: Asahi...?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You were sent to come and get us, Asahi?

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Yes! I volunteered when I heard that WXS would be coming to visit us!

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
The others also wanted to come...
But a big group would've been too conspicuous.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Oh, but don't worry! We decided by playing rock paper scissors, so it was all fair.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: R-Rock paper scissors...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
You haven't changed at all, Asahi.
Even though all the shows, movies and TV dramas must be keeping you really busy.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! You're still as smiley and cheerful as ever!

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Today, we'll be having an orientation session regarding the workshop. So, let's head right over to where all the others are.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Excellent! Please lead the way!
se_walk_men_001_4

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Fun, fun workshop♪
I wonder what we're gonna do☆

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Haha. You all sound very excited.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, that's because we are!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Will you also be participating in this workshop, Asahi?

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Yes, I'll be there for what I can when I don't have any work engagements.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: It's just been so long since we last got to work with WXS. And besides, this workshop is probably going to be our best one yet.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: It's going to be led by ArcLand's most veteran actors and directors.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Not only that, we've also invited some special guests.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Special guests?

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
Yes.
I'm sure you're also going to be surprised, Rui.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Me? Also...?)
se_walk_men_001_4

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Anyway, this is where it's taking place.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
First, you all need to say hi to everyone.
Some will be meeting Wonderlands×Showtime for the very first time.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Hey, you guys!
Orientation Venue

rows.Speaker: Workshop Host
rows.Line: I think it's safe to say that never before has ArcLand put on such a grand workshop.

rows.Speaker: Workshop Host
rows.Line: Workshop courses will take place in the gaps between normally scheduled practices and work, so it will likely be a very intensive experience.

rows.Speaker: Workshop Host
rows.Line:
But it should very much be worth it.
And we promise to provide you with all the support we can.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Asahi was right. They seem to be pulling out all the stops for this one.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (They have separate courses for actors and directors.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Plus, there will be a collaborative group assignment. I imagine the directors will devise shows, and the actors will perform them.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Hehe. I'm getting excited just thinking about it.)

rows.Speaker: Workshop Host
rows.Line: Now, I'd like to introduce the special instructors we've invited to join us for this workshop. First, for the actors' course...

rows.Speaker: Workshop Host
rows.Line: We have Natalia Santi, Glen Barkin and Elio Sakurai.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What...?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Natalia Santi?
She's won several international awards for her performances in musical films.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I had heard that she's been helping young actors hone their skills lately... But I wasn't expecting to hear her name here.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Me neither...
And Glen Barkin's one of the most famous actors on Broadway right now.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: He doesn't usually play the lead, but he has an incredible talent for playing memorable, demanding roles. His acting skills are supposed to be peerless...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wow, that means they're all really amazing!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, and Elio Sakurai is a world-class dancer.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: If I recall, he runs his own dance studio specifically tailored for performing in musicals.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Why do you know so much about him, Tsukasa?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: When we were taking ballet lessons at Morinomiya, I looked up videos on the subject. That was when I came across one of his explainer videos.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And he doesn't just cover ballet. He has videos covering everything from jazz to theatre dance. I ended up binge-watching them because they were so fascinating.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. They've gathered the best of the best.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I can't wait to talk to them!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (But you need more than just deep pockets to get guests like these to teach at your workshop.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (It's proof that ArcLand is just that invested in their shows, as well as the cast members who perform in them.)

rows.Speaker: Workshop Host
rows.Line: Next, I'd like to introduce the special guests we've invited for the directors' course.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, Rui, it's time for the people who are gonna teach you!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: After the names we just heard, my heart is kind of racing...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Mine too.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Getting to train here is a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (We have to make the absolute most of it.)
